diff --git a/mail/installer/linux/app/debian/manpage.1.in b/mail/installer/linux/app/debian/manpage.1.in
index a2f388bdbf0..82469207eb3 100644
--- a/mail/installer/linux/app/debian/manpage.1.in
+++ b/mail/installer/linux/app/debian/manpage.1.in
@@ -1,24 +1,24 @@
-.TH "${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME}" "1" "${DEB_MANPAGE_DATE}" "${DEB_PKG_NAME}" "Linux User's Manual"
+.TH "${DISPLAY_NAME}" "1" "${MANPAGE_DATE}" "${PKG_NAME}" "Linux User's Manual"
 .SH NAME
-${DEB_PKG_NAME} - ${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME} is a free and open source email, newsfeed, chat, and calendaring client
+${PKG_NAME} - ${DISPLAY_NAME} is a free and open source email, newsfeed, chat, and calendaring client
 .SH SYNOPSIS
-.B ${DEB_PKG_NAME}
+.B ${PKG_NAME}
 [\fIOPTIONS\fR] [\fIURL\fR]
 
-.B /usr/lib/${DEB_PKG_NAME}/${DEB_PKG_NAME}
+.B /usr/lib/${PKG_NAME}/${PKG_NAME}
 [\fIOPTIONS\fR] [\fIURL\fR]
 
 .SH DESCRIPTION
-\fB${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME}\fR is a free and open source email, newsfeed, chat, and
+\fB${DISPLAY_NAME}\fR is a free and open source email, newsfeed, chat, and
 calendaring client, that’s easy to set up and customize.
 
 .SH USAGE
-If there is a ${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME} mail client already running, \fB${DEB_PKG_NAME}\fR will
+If there is a ${DISPLAY_NAME} mail client already running, \fB${PKG_NAME}\fR will
 arrange for it to create a new mail client window; otherwise it will start
 a new instance.
 
 .SH OPTIONS
-A summary of the options supported by \fB${DEB_PKG_NAME}\fR is included below.
+A summary of the options supported by \fB${PKG_NAME}\fR is included below.
 
 .SS "X11 options"
 .TP
@@ -31,13 +31,13 @@ Make X calls synchronous
 .B \-\-g\-fatal\-warnings
 Make all warnings fatal
 
-.SS "${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME} options"
+.SS "${DISPLAY_NAME} options"
 .TP
 .B \-h, \-help
 Show summary of options.
 .TP
 .B \-v, \-version
-Print ${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME} version.
+Print ${DISPLAY_NAME} version.
 .TP
 \fB\-P\fR [\fIprofile\fR]
 Start with \fIprofile\fR. When no profile is given, displays the Profile Manager. May require \fB\-no\-remote\fR, see below.
@@ -52,16 +52,16 @@ Start with migration wizard. May require \fB\-no\-remote\fR, see below.
 Start with profile manager. May require \fB\-no\-remote\fR, see below.
 .TP
 .B \-\-no\-remote
-Don't connect to a running ${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME} instance. This option can be necessary
+Don't connect to a running ${DISPLAY_NAME} instance. This option can be necessary
 in conjunction to several of the options above, that won't have any effect
-when an ${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME} instance is running unless \fB\-no\-remote\fR is used at
+when an ${DISPLAY_NAME} instance is running unless \fB\-no\-remote\fR is used at
 the same time.
 .TP
 .B \-\-new\-instance
 Open a new instance instead of a new windows in the running instance.
 .TP
 .B \-\-safe\-mode
-Starts ${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME} in Troubleshoot Mode (previously Safe Mode),
+Starts ${DISPLAY_NAME} in Troubleshoot Mode (previously Safe Mode),
 i.e. disabling all extensions and showing a bit more debugging messages.
 .TP
 .B \-\-jsconsole
@@ -86,7 +86,7 @@ Open the message pointed to by \fIURL\fR.
 Open the news client.
 .TP
 .B \-setDefaultMail
-Set ${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME} as the default mail client.
+Set ${DISPLAY_NAME} as the default mail client.
 .TP
 .B \-options
 Open the options dialog.
@@ -100,18 +100,18 @@ Open the OpenPGP Key Manager.
 .SH DEBUGGING
 .TP
 .B \-g
-Starts ${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME} through a debugger (gdb by default).
+Starts ${DISPLAY_NAME} through a debugger (gdb by default).
 
 .SH ENVIRONMENT
 \fIMOZILLA_DISABLE_PLUGINS\fR - when set, totally disables loading plugins.
 
 .SH FILES
-\fI/usr/bin/${DEB_PKG_NAME}\fR - symbolic link to \fB/usr/lib/${DEB_PKG_NAME}/${DEB_PKG_NAME}\fR.
+\fI/usr/bin/${PKG_NAME}\fR - symbolic link to \fB/usr/lib/${PKG_NAME}/${PKG_NAME}\fR.
 .br
 
-\fI/usr/lib/${DEB_PKG_NAME}/${DEB_PKG_NAME}\fR - ${DEB_DISPLAY_NAME} executable.
+\fI/usr/lib/${PKG_NAME}/${PKG_NAME}\fR - ${DISPLAY_NAME} executable.
 
-\fI/usr/lib/${DEB_PKG_NAME}/thunderbird\-bin\fR - Legacy executable.
+\fI/usr/lib/${PKG_NAME}/thunderbird\-bin\fR - Legacy executable.
 .br
 
 .SH BUGS
